title: Special Height and Setback Provision in the South Subdistrict
previewText: For zoning lots that coincide with, or are completely within, the boundaries of Parcel 19 in the South Subdistrict, as shown on Map 1 in the Appendix to this Chapter, the setback provisions of Section 62-34 (Height and Setback Regulations on Waterfront Blocks) shall be modified to require an initial setback distance with a depth of 15 feet from the boundary of a shore public walkway.
